question: The correct chemical formula of the compound Magnesium Hydroxide is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mg(OH)2**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **correct chemical formula of the compound Magnesium Hydroxide is Mg(OH)₂​**
 
• **Magnesium hydroxide** is a compound made of two components:
 
• **Magnesium (Mg)** – a metal from Group 2 of the periodic table.
 
 
• It has a valency of **+2** (because it loses two electrons to become stable).
 
 
 
• **Hydroxide (OH)** – a polyatomic ion.
 
 
• It has a valency of **-1** (because it gains one electron).
 
 
 
• To form a neutral compound, the total positive charges must balance the total negative charges.
